title: MB classes
desc: Link MB Platform courses to tags by course ID. Every hour, each tag holds exactly the students with an active enrollment in the courses linked to it.
warning: The tag becomes controlled by the sync: contacts added by hand (on any number) are removed on the next run. Removing a pair does not clear the tag.
removeDesc: The tag stops syncing with this course and keeps its current members.
lookupError: Could not look up the course.
